title: Finite root-power generators detect maps
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and a scheme T, using [def-pur-twist-sheaves, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Fix n≥0 and let A be the constant coefficient sheaf A_(E,n+1), L=A(1) and a range over its constant scalar ring [def-pur-finite-tate-site-comparison]. Let G_d(V,a,x) be any family of sections of L^tensor d with x:Fin d→Z_l(1)(V), satisfying the following equations: G_0 is the constant-section image of a; G_1(V,a,(x)) is finiteTateProGenerator(a,x); G_(d+2) is the sheaf pure tensor of G_(d+1) on the first d+1 roots with finiteTateProGenerator(1,last root). For every d≥0, every A-module sheaf N and any f,g:L^tensor d→N, if f and g agree on G_d(V,a,x) for every site object V, scalar a and root tuple x, then f=g. No local freeness, inverse image, or isomorphism is assumed.

proof.text: At degree one use the sheafification adjunction for both the finite scalar extension and its integral scalar extension. Tensor generation reduces equality to pure scalar/root tensors. Scalar linearity moves the scalar into the target. The completed action restricts to the discrete action by its normalization, so these are the stated generators.

proof.text: Inductively each factor is locally generated by its scalar/root generators. Every section of a sheaf tensor locally lifts to a finite sum of pure tensors. Refine the covers for the two factors to a common cover, expand bilinearly, and move the product of the scalars to the first factor. This expresses each summand as a displayed nested G_(d+2). The assumed equality therefore holds locally and descends by separatedness. This proves local generation and extensionality simultaneously, including vanishing root groups and the empty scheme.

theorem finiteRootPower_hom_ext
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (G : ∀ (d : ℕ) (V : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a : finiteTateCoefficient l E n),
      (Fin d → (purTwistZlOne T l).obj.obj V) →
        (coefficientTwistPower T (R := (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E T n))
          (purTwistFiniteOne T l E n) d).val.obj V)
    (hzero : ∀ V a x, G 0 V a x = (realizationRingUnit (ProEt.topology T) (finiteTateCoefficient l E
      n)).app V a)
    (hone : ∀ V a x, G 1 V a (fun _ ↦ x) =
      finiteTateProGenerator l E n T V a x)
    (hsucc : ∀ d V a x, G (d + 2) V a x =
      SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorTmul.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
        (coefficientTwistPower T (R := (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E T n))
          (purTwistFiniteOne T l E n) (d + 1))
        (purTwistFiniteOne T l E n) V (G (d + 1) V a (fun i ↦ x i.castSucc))
        (finiteTateProGenerator l E n T V 1 (x (Fin.last (d + 1)))))
    (d : ℕ) (N : proEtaleRingModules T (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E T n))
    (f g : coefficientTwistPower T (R := (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E T n))
      (purTwistFiniteOne T l E n) d ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ V a x, f.val.app V (G d V a x) = g.val.app V (G d V a x)) :
    f = g
